name: vora
description: Streaming voice question answering on CPU. The page in client/ is plain ES modules served by the Python server, so there is no build step.

scripts.dev: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -m vora.server; else exec python -m vora.server; fi'
scripts.test: node --test client/tests && sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -m pytest -m "not perf and not eval and not integration"; else exec python -m pytest -m "not perf and not eval and not integration"; fi'
